glyph_origin: Originally written 𠄡, consisting of 㐅 with a bar on the top and bottom. Original meaning is unclear. Theories include: • Yu Shenwu: a tally mark. • Ding Shan: original form of 互 (“to cross”). • Zhang Bingquan: Pictogram (象形): palm lines from extending ones fingers • Ji Xusheng: 亖 (“four”) with an added stroke. • Lin Yiguang: original meaning is jiāowǔ 交午, with 午 being the original form of the wooden pestle. In 韋, the upper component (𫝀) is the stylization of a footprint, hence it is similar but unrelated to 五.
